about_the_game:
Capybara Cafe Chronicles is a cozy blend of romance visual novel and relaxing puzzle game—set in a charming cafe run entirely by capybaras.

To escape your financial hardship, you’ve taken a job at a quiet little coffee shop in a sleepy town—where the locals are kind, the pastries are warm, and the capybaras? Well… they talk, wear little aprons, and might just steal your heart. And did we say, they have handsome human forms at night?!

✨ Features

  • Cozy storytelling: Enjoy a cozy, feel-good narrative full of warmth, humor, and a touch of whimsy.

  • 3 romance options: Choose from a lovable cast of capybara characters, each with their own personality, backstory, and unique romance route.

  • Charming puzzle mini-games: Brew drinks, arrange flowers, bake pastries and solve cafe conundrums to keep the capybara and customer crew happy.

  • Multiple endings: Your choices shape your relationship and the future of the cafe.

  • Love meter and resonance stat: Build your bond with each love interest in distinct ways. Strengthen your connection to unlock exclusive scenes, hidden secrets, and character-specific collectibles. Every choice shapes your relationship—and reveals more than meets the eye.

  • Unique collectibles for each love interest: Each love interest has their own set of thematic collectibles unlocking secret lore, emotional flashbacks,

  • Cute art & relaxing vibes: Unique anime-style visuals and a gentle soundtrack to help you unwind.

Whether you're here for the puzzles, the story, or to finally go on a date with a giant rodent in a bowtie, Capybara Cafe Chronicles is a fluffy little escape from the real world.
